designSummary: Descriptive mapping; no inferential statistics and no pooling.
sampleSize: The unit is the study and the number is set by the search: about 2,400 titles at 30 seconds each (20 hours), about 250 full texts at 10 minutes (42 hours) and about 150 included studies charted at 30 minutes (75 hours), about 137 hours within the registrar's three months alongside other duties. If more than 200 studies are eligible, charting is limited to studies from 2015 onward and the restriction is reported.
primaryAnalysis: Frequency of each methods choice (made, not made, not reported) overall and by period (2010 to 2019, 2020 onward), shown as a heat map of studies by choice.
secondaryAnalysis: Separate reporting for care home residents; vaccination source; agreement on double screening (kappa).
missingData: Not reported is a category, never imputed.
software: Charting in a shared spreadsheet; figures in R.
overfittingGuards: Charting items fixed in the registered protocol
summary: About 137 hours of work for about 150 studies; descriptive map by period.
